title: Power Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the power required as P = 9.5 x 10^4 W.

title: Weight of Copper
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly determine the weight of the necessary copper as 3.8 kg.

title: Force of Attraction
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately compute the force of attraction as F = 8 x 10^5 N.

title: Use of Ampère's Law
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply Ampère's circuital law correctly in the context of the problem.

title: Current Density Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly use the maximum current density to find the necessary current and cross-sectional area.

title: Resistivity Usage
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly incorporate the resistivity of copper in the power calculation.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Final Answer Formatting
description: Optional Criteria: The student should present final answers clearly and in the correct format.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign errors in calculations, especially in power and force.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit any necessary factors in the equations used for calculations.
